        coeffs

            y) •

            ⟨↑i, Decidable.byContradiction fun a ↦ qMap_total_fiber_repr_coeff._proof_2 i 1 a⟩

            ⟨↑i, Decidable.byContradiction fun a ↦ qMap_total_fiber_repr_coeff._proof_2 i 1 a⟩
